checks: invalid RPC and failed storage leave settings unchanged; saving custom metadata makes no wallet or endpoint request and preserves Lenz state
network selection connects from an initially unsupported wallet; built-in switching requires wallet confirmation and shows the checked destination
custom RPC sharing requires consent; registration and switching are separate; exact custom balance/currency and decoded Receive QR never enable Send or alter prior history
network details and compact configuration fit both themes at 320–1280px, with keyboard containment in landscape, reduced motion and doubled root text
declined switches clear stale balances; closing during a delayed switch blocks same-event late replies and preserves the unresolved transfer
revoking custom-network consent during a pending switch prevents all subsequent balance reads and session activation
reload retains custom settings but resets consent; another tab’s settings change disconnects; removal leaves pending transfer history and its send barrier intact
offline reload preserves network settings, Lenz state and transfer journal with no eager wallet, custom RPC, signing or financial request
scope: Disposable Edge with injected wallet, real local persistence, decoded QR and offline cache. No installed wallet, actual network/RPC validation, device or financial operation.
